2	# Demo (SimPoint stage: archive + replay) on the RVV GEMM workload.
3	#
4	# Step A (archive): orchestrator runs a single-spawn QEMU plan that drains
5	#   on the CSR-enter trigger and archives state.bin + mem + meta.json
6	#   under $WORKDIR/snap/0/.
7	# Step B (replay): orchestrator replay-checkpoint hydrates $WORKDIR/snap/0/
8	#   into a fresh /dev/shm mmap and resumes the chosen model (vsim by
9	#   default), proving the archive is portable across sessions.
10	#
11	# Env (auto-detected with sensible defaults):
12	#   VSIM_QEMU     qemu-system-riscv64
13	#   VSIM_PLUGIN   libhybrid_handoff.so
14	#   VSIM_BIN      sim_<cpu>
15	#   VSIM_ELF      marked C-level Tier-2 fixture (default: rt_c_v_matmul.elf)
16	#   WORKDIR       persistent dir for snap + replay state (default: mktemp -d)
17	#   RESUME_WITH   vsim | qemu (default: vsim)
18	
19	set -euo pipefail
20	
21	SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
22	. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/paths.sh"
23	
24	FIXTURE="${FIXTURE:-rt_c_v_matmul}"
25	WORKDIR="${WORKDIR:-$(mktemp -d -t demo-archive-XXXXXX)}"
26	RESUME_WITH="${RESUME_WITH:-vsim}"
27	
28	MODE_LABEL="SimPoint stage: archive emit + checkpoint replay"
29	echo "=========================================================="
30	echo "Mode: $MODE_LABEL"
31	echo "Fixture: rt_c_v_matmul (RVV 16x16x16 GEMM)"
32	echo "Step A: orchestrator run plan -> snap/0/{state.bin, mem, meta.json}"
33	echo "Step B: orchestrator replay-checkpoint --resume-with $RESUME_WITH"
34	echo "Workdir: $WORKDIR"
35	echo "=========================================================="
36	
37	hybrid_resolve_paths
38	if ! command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
39	  echo "[demo archive] SKIP: python3 not found"
40	  exit 77
41	fi
42	
43	mkdir -p "$WORKDIR"
44	PLAN_YAML="$WORKDIR/plan_archive.yaml"
45	ARCHIVE_ROOT="$WORKDIR"
46	RUN_WORKDIR="$WORKDIR/run"
47	REPLAY_WORKDIR="$WORKDIR/replay"
48	RUN_LOG="$WORKDIR/run.log"
49	REPLAY_LOG="$WORKDIR/replay.log"
50	
51	# Single-step plan: QEMU drains on CSR-enter and archives.
52	cat >"$PLAN_YAML" <<EOF
53	session:
54	  mem_size: 134217728
55	  mmap_path: null
56	  elf: tests/fixtures/rt_c_v_matmul.elf
57	
58	steps:
59	  - model: qemu
60	    trigger: { kind: csr }
61	    on_exit: { archive_as: "snap/0" }
62	EOF
63	
64	echo "[demo archive 1/4] orchestrator run: drain + archive"
65	mkdir -p "$RUN_WORKDIR"
66	set +e
67	PYTHONPATH="$TOP_ROOT/tools" VSIM_QEMU="$VSIM_QEMU" VSIM_PLUGIN="$VSIM_PLUGIN" VSIM_BIN="$VSIM_BIN" \
68	  python3 -m orchestrator.main run "$PLAN_YAML" \
69	    --project-root "$TOP_ROOT" \
70	    --workdir "$RUN_WORKDIR" \
71	    --archive-root "$ARCHIVE_ROOT" \
72	    >"$RUN_LOG" 2>&1
73	RUN_RC=$?
74	set -e
75	
76	if [ "$RUN_RC" -ne 200 ] && [ "$RUN_RC" -ne 0 ]; then
77	  echo "[demo archive] FAIL: orchestrator run exited $RUN_RC"
78	  tail -30 "$RUN_LOG"
79	  exit 1
80	fi
81	
82	SNAP_DIR="$ARCHIVE_ROOT/snap/0"
83	for f in state.bin mem meta.json; do
84	  if [ ! -s "$SNAP_DIR/$f" ]; then
85	    echo "[demo archive] FAIL: missing or empty $SNAP_DIR/$f"
86	    ls -la "$SNAP_DIR" 2>&1 || true
87	    tail -30 "$RUN_LOG"
88	    exit 1
89	  fi
90	done
91	
92	echo "[demo archive 2/4] validate meta.json schema"
93	META_OK=$(python3 - "$SNAP_DIR/meta.json" <<'PY'
94	import json, sys
95	meta = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
96	assert meta.get("schema") == 1, f"schema {meta.get('schema')!r}"
97	assert meta.get("abi_version") == 1, f"abi_version {meta.get('abi_version')!r}"
98	assert meta.get("abi_magic", "").lower() in ("0x42594841", "42594841"), \
99	    f"abi_magic {meta.get('abi_magic')!r}"
100	assert meta.get("mem_size") == 134217728, f"mem_size {meta.get('mem_size')!r}"
101	print("schema=1 abi_version=1 abi_magic=0x42594841 mem_size=128MB")
102	PY
103	)
104	echo "  $META_OK"
105	
106	echo "[demo archive 3/4] orchestrator replay-checkpoint --resume-with $RESUME_WITH"
107	mkdir -p "$REPLAY_WORKDIR"
108	set +e
109	PYTHONPATH="$TOP_ROOT/tools" VSIM_QEMU="$VSIM_QEMU" VSIM_PLUGIN="$VSIM_PLUGIN" VSIM_BIN="$VSIM_BIN" \
110	  python3 -m orchestrator.main replay-checkpoint "$SNAP_DIR" \
111	    --resume-with "$RESUME_WITH" \
112	    --project-root "$TOP_ROOT" \
113	    --workdir "$REPLAY_WORKDIR" \
114	    >"$REPLAY_LOG" 2>&1
115	REPLAY_RC=$?
116	set -e
117	
118	if [ "$REPLAY_RC" -ne 0 ] && [ "$REPLAY_RC" -ne 200 ]; then
119	  echo "[demo archive] FAIL: replay-checkpoint exited $REPLAY_RC"
120	  tail -30 "$REPLAY_LOG"
121	  exit 1
122	fi
123	
124	echo "[demo archive 4/4] verify replay advanced PC past archive"
125	REPLAY_STATE=""
126	for cand in "$REPLAY_WORKDIR"/*state*.bin "$REPLAY_WORKDIR"/*.bin; do
127	  if [ -s "$cand" ]; then
128	    REPLAY_STATE="$cand"
129	    break
130	  fi
131	done
132	if [ -z "$REPLAY_STATE" ]; then
133	  echo "  no post-replay state file produced (replay completed at exit; OK)"
134	else
135	  ARCHIVE_PC=$(python3 -c "
136	import struct
137	print(hex(struct.unpack('<Q', open('$SNAP_DIR/state.bin', 'rb').read()[16:24])[0]))")
138	  REPLAY_PC=$(python3 -c "
139	import struct
140	print(hex(struct.unpack('<Q', open('$REPLAY_STATE', 'rb').read()[16:24])[0]))")
141	  echo "  archive pc=$ARCHIVE_PC, replay-drain pc=$REPLAY_PC"
142	  if [ "$ARCHIVE_PC" = "$REPLAY_PC" ]; then
143	    echo "[demo archive] WARN: replay PC equals archive PC (no progress?)"
144	  fi
145	fi
146	
147	echo "[demo archive] PASS ($MODE_LABEL): snap/0 archived + replayed under $RESUME_WITH"
148

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Demo (SimPoint stage: bbv profile + cluster) on the RVV GEMM workload.
3	#
4	# QEMU + plugin runs the markerless GEMM twin with bbv_out=PATH,slice=N,
5	# icount=M. Plugin writes one SimPoint .bb row per N retired insns; expected
6	# rows = M/N. Then tools/simpoint/bin/simpoint clusters the .bb file and
7	# produces simpts (slice -> cluster) + weights (cluster -> mass).
8	#
9	# This is SimPoint stage 1: pick representative phases. Outputs are persisted
10	# under $WORKDIR so the slice / loop stages can consume them. WORKDIR is
11	# printed on PASS.
12	#
13	# Env (auto-detected with sensible defaults):
14	#   VSIM_QEMU     qemu-system-riscv64
15	#   VSIM_PLUGIN   libhybrid_handoff.so
16	#   VSIM_ELF      markerless fixture (default: rt_c_v_matmul_free.elf)
17	#   SIMPOINT_BIN  the built simpoint clustering binary
18	#   WORKDIR       persistent dir for bbv/simpts/weights (default: mktemp -d)
19	#   SLICE         insns per BBV row (default: 1000)
20	#   ICOUNT        total insns before drain (default: 10000)
21	#   MAXK          simpoint -maxK (default: 2; tiny BBVs need conservative K)
22	
23	set -euo pipefail
24	
25	SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
26	. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/paths.sh"
27	
28	FIXTURE="${FIXTURE:-rt_c_v_matmul_free}"
29	hybrid_resolve_paths
30	SIMPOINT_BIN="${SIMPOINT_BIN:-$TOP_ROOT/tools/simpoint/bin/simpoint}"
31	WORKDIR="${WORKDIR:-$(mktemp -d -t demo-bbv-XXXXXX)}"
32	SLICE="${SLICE:-1000}"
33	ICOUNT="${ICOUNT:-10000}"
34	MAXK="${MAXK:-2}"
35	
36	MODE_LABEL="SimPoint stage: BBV emit + cluster"
37	echo "=========================================================="
38	echo "Mode: $MODE_LABEL"
39	echo "Workload: ${FIXTURE} (markerless RVV GEMM, 200 reps)"
40	echo "Plugin: bbv_out=...,slice=$SLICE,icount=$ICOUNT"
41	echo "Workdir: $WORKDIR"
42	echo "=========================================================="
43	
44	if [ ! -x "$SIMPOINT_BIN" ]; then
45	  echo "[demo bbv] SKIP: $SIMPOINT_BIN not built"
46	  exit 77
47	fi
48	
49	mkdir -p "$WORKDIR"
50	BBV_OUT="$WORKDIR/rt_c_v_matmul_free.bb"
51	SIMPTS="$WORKDIR/simpts"
52	WEIGHTS="$WORKDIR/weights"
53	STATE_OUT="$WORKDIR/state_qemu.bin"
54	QEMU_LOG="$WORKDIR/qemu.log"
55	SP_LOG="$WORKDIR/simpoint.log"
56	
57	SHARED_SIZE=$((128 * 1024 * 1024))
58	SHARED_MEM=$(mktemp -p /dev/shm vsim-bbv-shared.XXXXXX)
59	trap 'rm -f "$SHARED_MEM"' EXIT
60	truncate -s "$SHARED_SIZE" "$SHARED_MEM"
61	
62	EXPECTED_ROWS=$((ICOUNT / SLICE))
63	
64	echo "[demo bbv 1/3] QEMU + plugin: emit BBV ($EXPECTED_ROWS rows expected)"
65	set +e
66	timeout 30 "$VSIM_QEMU" \
67	  -object "memory-backend-file,id=mem,share=on,mem-path=$SHARED_MEM,size=$SHARED_SIZE" \
68	  -machine andes_ae350,memory-backend=mem \
69	  -cpu andes-ax45mpv,vlen=512 \
70	  -nographic \
71	  -semihosting-config enable=on,target=native \
72	  -bios "$VSIM_ELF" \
73	  -plugin "$VSIM_PLUGIN,outfile=$STATE_OUT,icount=$ICOUNT,bbv_out=$BBV_OUT,slice=$SLICE" \
74	  </dev/null >"$QEMU_LOG" 2>&1
75	RC=$?
76	set -e
77	
78	if [ "$RC" -ne 200 ]; then
79	  echo "[demo bbv] FAIL: QEMU expected exit 200, got $RC"
80	  tail -20 "$QEMU_LOG"
81	  exit 1
82	fi
83	
84	ROWS=$(wc -l < "$BBV_OUT")
85	if [ "$ROWS" -ne "$EXPECTED_ROWS" ]; then
86	  echo "[demo bbv] FAIL: expected $EXPECTED_ROWS BBV rows, got $ROWS"
87	  exit 1
88	fi
89	
90	echo "[demo bbv 2/3] SimPoint cluster: maxK=$MAXK"
91	set +e
92	"$SIMPOINT_BIN" -loadFVFile "$BBV_OUT" -maxK "$MAXK" -dim 2 \
93	  -saveSimpoints "$SIMPTS" -saveSimpointWeights "$WEIGHTS" \
94	  >"$SP_LOG" 2>&1
95	SP_RC=$?
96	set -e
97	
98	if [ "$SP_RC" -ne 0 ]; then
99	  echo "[demo bbv] FAIL: simpoint exit $SP_RC"
100	  tail -20 "$SP_LOG"
101	  exit 1
102	fi
103	
104	# The GEMM repeats one kernel, so its BBV rows are near-identical and simpoint
105	# may collapse to a single cluster -- assert non-empty output, not a fixed K.
106	if [ ! -s "$SIMPTS" ] || [ ! -s "$WEIGHTS" ]; then
107	  echo "[demo bbv] FAIL: simpoint output empty (simpts=$(wc -c <"$SIMPTS") weights=$(wc -c <"$WEIGHTS"))"
108	  exit 1
109	fi
110	
111	echo "[demo bbv 3/3] Chosen phases:"
112	echo "  simpts (slice_idx cluster_id):"
113	awk '{printf "    %s\n", $0}' "$SIMPTS"
114	echo "  weights (mass cluster_id):"
115	awk '{printf "    %s\n", $0}' "$WEIGHTS"
116	
117	# Informational: weights should sum to ~1.0 (no hard assert; simpoint
118	# may emit weights in unnormalised form for some -maxK paths).
119	SUM=$(awk '{s+=$1} END{printf "%.4f", s}' "$WEIGHTS")
120	echo "  weight sum: $SUM"
121	
122	echo "[demo bbv] PASS ($MODE_LABEL): rows=$ROWS, clusters=$(wc -l <"$SIMPTS"), workdir=$WORKDIR"
123

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Demo (SimPoint stage: slice-consume): drain QEMU at a slice boundary, then
3	# measure a window in vsim -- on the RVV GEMM workload.
4	#
5	# Shows the orchestrator using DIFFERENT trigger modes for the entry and exit
6	# of the same vsim window:
7	#
8	#   QEMU + plugin: slice=N,slice_at=K -> drains at end of slice K.
9	#   vsim         : --hybrid-icount M  -> drains after M retired insns.
10	#
11	# Workload is the MARKERLESS GEMM twin rt_c_v_matmul_free (no csrwi 0x7C0), so
12	# neither side can use the marker -- slice/icount ARE the only triggers. There
13	# is no natural end-of-program drain (the demo stops vsim mid-kernel by count);
14	# it asserts the round-trip DRAINS at both ends with both PCs inside the GEMM
15	# kernel.
16	#
17	# Env (auto-detected with sensible defaults):
18	#   VSIM_QEMU     qemu-system-riscv64
19	#   VSIM_PLUGIN   libhybrid_handoff.so
20	#   VSIM_BIN      sim_<cpu>
21	#   VSIM_ELF      markerless fixture (default: rt_c_v_matmul_free.elf)
22	#   SLICE         insns per slice    (default: 1000)
23	#   SLICE_AT      0-based slice index for drain (default: 1)
24	#   ICOUNT_FALLBACK QEMU plugin safety upper bound (default: 10000)
25	#   VSIM_ICOUNT   insns vsim runs before exit drain (default: 5000)
26	#   SIMPTS        optional simpts file from the bbv stage; if set, slice_at
27	#                 picked from its first row (first column) instead of SLICE_AT.
28	
29	set -euo pipefail
30	
31	SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
32	. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/paths.sh"
33	
34	FIXTURE="${FIXTURE:-rt_c_v_matmul_free}"
35	SLICE="${SLICE:-1000}"
36	SLICE_AT_ENV="${SLICE_AT:-1}"
37	ICOUNT_FALLBACK="${ICOUNT_FALLBACK:-10000}"
38	VSIM_ICOUNT="${VSIM_ICOUNT:-5000}"
39	SIMPTS="${SIMPTS:-}"
40	
41	# If a SIMPTS file from the bbv stage is provided, pick the first listed slice
42	# index. Otherwise fall back to SLICE_AT env (default 1).
43	if [ -n "$SIMPTS" ] && [ -s "$SIMPTS" ]; then
44	  SLICE_AT=$(awk 'NR==1{print $1}' "$SIMPTS")
45	  SLICE_AT_SRC="simpts(first row of $SIMPTS)"
46	else
47	  SLICE_AT="$SLICE_AT_ENV"
48	  SLICE_AT_SRC="env SLICE_AT"
49	fi
50	
51	MODE_LABEL="SimPoint stage: slice-consume entry + icount exit"
52	echo "=========================================================="
53	echo "Mode: $MODE_LABEL"
54	echo "Workload: ${FIXTURE} (markerless RVV GEMM, 200 reps)"
55	echo "Entry: QEMU plugin slice=$SLICE slice_at=$SLICE_AT (from $SLICE_AT_SRC)"
56	echo "Exit : vsim --hybrid-icount $VSIM_ICOUNT"
57	echo "=========================================================="
58	
59	hybrid_resolve_paths
60	
61	# Resolve the GEMM kernel range so the drain checks assert the slice/icount
62	# targets landed inside vmatmul_kernel (readelf -sW: $2=value $3=size $8=name).
63	RE="${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN:+$HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-readelf}"
64	RE="${RE:-riscv64-unknown-elf-readelf}"
65	read KLO KSZ < <("$RE" -sW "$VSIM_ELF" | awk '$8=="vmatmul_kernel"{print strtonum("0x"$2),$3; exit}')
66	if [ -z "${KLO:-}" ] || [ -z "${KSZ:-}" ]; then
67	  echo "[demo slice] FAIL: could not resolve vmatmul_kernel range from $VSIM_ELF"; exit 1
68	fi
69	pc_in_kernel() { awk -v p="$1" -v lo="$KLO" -v sz="$KSZ" 'BEGIN{exit !(p>=lo && p<lo+sz)}'; }

2	# Acceptance test for gemm_modes.md: every demo runs the SAME RVV GEMM
3	# (rt_c_v_matmul.c), so the suite reads as "one workload, the 4 switching
4	# modes". Marker-driven demos (csr / archive / simpoint) use the MARKED build;
5	# count- and PC-driven demos (icount / bbv / slice / pc) use the MARKERLESS
6	# twin (pc anchors on the objdump-derived inner-loop boundary in vmatmul_kernel).
7	#
8	# Pure parsing of each demo's default FIXTURE -- no artifacts, no round-trip.
9	# Goes fully green only once F3..F8 have swapped every demo; until then it
10	# names exactly which demos still point at an old fixture.
11	
12	set -uo pipefail
13	
14	SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
15	
16	# demo file -> expected default fixture
17	declare -A EXPECT=(
18	  [demo_csr_oneshot.sh]=rt_c_v_matmul
19	  [demo_pc_oneshot.sh]=rt_c_v_matmul_free
20	  [demo_icount_roundtrip.sh]=rt_c_v_matmul_free
21	  [demo_bbv_profile.sh]=rt_c_v_matmul_free
22	  [demo_slice_consume_roundtrip.sh]=rt_c_v_matmul_free

28	# written `FIXTURE=foo ...` (csr/pc inline env) or `FIXTURE="${FIXTURE:-foo}"`.
29	# \K drops everything matched so far, leaving just the fixture token.
30	fixture_of() {
31	  grep -oP 'FIXTURE=(?:"?\$\{FIXTURE:-)?\K[A-Za-z0-9_]+' "$1" | head -1
32	}

34	bad=0

36	  f="$SCRIPT_DIR/$demo"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# End-to-end roundtrip harness: QEMU 1 + plugin -> vsim -> QEMU 2.
3	#
4	# Memory between QEMU and vsim is shared via an /dev/shm-backed mmap
5	# (128 MB). Works for both asm fixtures (handoff_roundtrip, rt_*) and
6	# C-level fixtures (rt_c_*). C fixtures require shared mmap so the
7	# stack/heap survives handoffs; asm fixtures don't need it but run
8	# fine with it.
9	#
10	# Env:
11	#   FIXTURE         REQUIRED. .elf name under tests/fixtures/ (no .elf suffix).
12	#   EXPECT_RC       Final exit code to assert (default 0).
13	#   TRIGGER_MODE    csr | pc (default csr).
14	#   ROI_START       pc mode only. Switch-in PC: a 0x address or a symbol in
15	#                   $VSIM_ELF (default: _hybrid_enter_pc).
16	#   ROI_END         pc mode only. Switch-out PC, same forms
17	#                   (default: _hybrid_exit_pc).
18	#   TIMEOUT         vsim leg timeout in seconds (default 60).
19	#   CHECK_MCYCLE_MONOTONIC=1   assert mcycle/minstret strictly increased
20	#                              between QEMU 1's drain and vsim's drain.
21	#   VSIM_BIN, VSIM_QEMU, VSIM_PLUGIN, VSIM_ELF, NM  override built paths.
22	
23	set -euo pipefail
24	
25	SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
26	. "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/paths.sh"
27	. "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/roi.sh"
28	
29	FIXTURE="${FIXTURE:?FIXTURE env var is required (e.g. FIXTURE=rt_c_hello)}"
30	EXPECT_RC="${EXPECT_RC:-0}"
31	TIMEOUT="${TIMEOUT:-60}"
32	TRIGGER_MODE="${TRIGGER_MODE:-csr}"
33	
34	hybrid_resolve_paths
35	
36	NM="${NM:-${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN:+$HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-nm}}"
37	NM="${NM:-riscv64-unknown-elf-nm}"
38	
39	case "$TRIGGER_MODE" in
40	  csr) ;;
41	  pc)
42	    if ! command -v "$NM" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
43	      echo "skip[$FIXTURE pc]: nm not found at $NM"
44	      exit 77
45	    fi
46	    NM_OUT=$("$NM" --defined-only "$VSIM_ELF")
47	    # ROI_START / ROI_END (env) name the two switch PCs: each is a 0x address
48	    # or a symbol in $VSIM_ELF. Default to the planted _hybrid_enter_pc /
49	    # _hybrid_exit_pc markers, so existing fixtures need no change.
50	    roi_resolve_pair "$NM_OUT" "$FIXTURE pc" || exit 1
51	    ;;
52	  *)
53	    echo "FAIL[$FIXTURE]: unknown TRIGGER_MODE=$TRIGGER_MODE (use csr|pc)"
54	    exit 1
55	    ;;
56	esac
57	
58	# 128 MB matches the QEMU virt machine default; vsim uses the same size.
59	SHARED_SIZE=$((128 * 1024 * 1024))
60	SHARED_MEM=$(mktemp -p /dev/shm vsim-e2e-shared.XXXXXX)
61	STATE_QEMU=$(mktemp)
62	STATE_VSIM=$(mktemp)
63	SIM_LOG=$(mktemp)
64	trap 'rm -f "$SHARED_MEM" "$STATE_QEMU" "$STATE_VSIM" "$SIM_LOG"' EXIT
65	truncate -s "$SHARED_SIZE" "$SHARED_MEM"
66	
67	PLUGIN_ARGS="outfile=$STATE_QEMU"
68	VSIM_TRIG_ARGS=()
69	if [ "$TRIGGER_MODE" = "pc" ]; then
70	  PLUGIN_ARGS="$PLUGIN_ARGS,enter_pc=0x$ENTER_PC"
71	  VSIM_TRIG_ARGS=(--hybrid-exit-pc "0x$EXIT_PC")
72	fi
73	
74	echo "[$FIXTURE 1/3 mode=$TRIGGER_MODE] QEMU 1: drain entry state"
75	set +e
76	"$VSIM_QEMU" \
77	  -object "memory-backend-file,id=mem,share=on,mem-path=$SHARED_MEM,size=$SHARED_SIZE" \
78	  -machine andes_ae350,memory-backend=mem \
79	  -cpu andes-ax45mpv,vlen=512 \
80	  -nographic \
81	  -semihosting-config enable=on,target=native \
82	  -bios "$VSIM_ELF" \
83	  -plugin "$VSIM_PLUGIN,$PLUGIN_ARGS" >/dev/null 2>&1
84	QEMU1_RC=$?
85	set -e
86	
87	if [ "$QEMU1_RC" -ne 200 ]; then
88	  echo "FAIL[$FIXTURE]: QEMU 1 expected exit 200 on drain, got $QEMU1_RC"
89	  exit 1
90	fi
91	
92	if [ ! -s "$STATE_QEMU" ]; then
93	  echo "FAIL[$FIXTURE]: QEMU 1 did not produce state"
94	  exit 1
95	fi
96	
97	echo "[$FIXTURE 2/3 mode=$TRIGGER_MODE] vsim: resume + drain + spawn QEMU 2"
98	set +e
99	timeout "$TIMEOUT" "$VSIM_BIN" "$VSIM_ELF" \
100	  --resume-from-qemu "$STATE_QEMU" \
101	  --handoff-out "$STATE_VSIM" \
102	  --shared-mem-path "$SHARED_MEM" \
103	  --shared-mem-size "$SHARED_SIZE" \
104	  --shared-mem-base 0x00000000 \
105	  --qemu-binary "$VSIM_QEMU" \
106	  "${VSIM_TRIG_ARGS[@]}" >"$SIM_LOG" 2>&1
107	RC=$?
108	set -e
109	
110	# Kernel cycles (always) + opt-in monotonic check. Offsets locked by
111	# state_abi_check.h (mcycle@624, minstret@632). vsim restores mcycle from
112	# QEMU 1's drain then counts real clock cycles, so vsim_mcycle - qemu1_mcycle
113	# is the measured region's cycle count. Runs before the RC gate so the
114	# verdict is independent of any downstream-phase failure.
115	if [ -s "$STATE_VSIM" ] && [ -s "$STATE_QEMU" ]; then
116	  read_u64_le() { od -A n -j "$1" -N 8 -t u8 "$2" | tr -d ' \n'; }
117	  Q1_MCYCLE=$(read_u64_le 624 "$STATE_QEMU")
118	  Q1_MINST=$(read_u64_le  632 "$STATE_QEMU")
119	  V_MCYCLE=$(read_u64_le  624 "$STATE_VSIM")
120	  V_MINST=$(read_u64_le   632 "$STATE_VSIM")
121	  echo "[$FIXTURE kernel_cycles] $((V_MCYCLE - Q1_MCYCLE))  (vsim mcycle=$V_MCYCLE - qemu1 mcycle=$Q1_MCYCLE)"
122	  if [ "${CHECK_MCYCLE_MONOTONIC:-0}" = "1" ]; then
123	    echo "[$FIXTURE mcycle/minstret] qemu1: mcycle=$Q1_MCYCLE minstret=$Q1_MINST"
124	    echo "[$FIXTURE mcycle/minstret] vsim:  mcycle=$V_MCYCLE minstret=$V_MINST"
125	    if [ "$V_MCYCLE" -le "$Q1_MCYCLE" ]; then
126	      echo "FAIL[$FIXTURE]: mcycle not strictly increasing across vsim"
127	      exit 1
128	    fi
129	    if [ "$V_MINST" -le "$Q1_MINST" ]; then
130	      echo "FAIL[$FIXTURE]: minstret not strictly increasing across vsim"
131	      exit 1
132	    fi
133	    echo "[$FIXTURE mcycle/minstret] PASS: strictly increasing"
134	  fi
135	fi
136	
137	if [ "$RC" != "$EXPECT_RC" ]; then
138	  echo "FAIL[$FIXTURE]: expected exit $EXPECT_RC, got $RC"
139	  echo "--- sim log ---"
140	  cat "$SIM_LOG"
141	  exit 1
142	fi
143	
144	echo "[$FIXTURE 3/3 mode=$TRIGGER_MODE] PASS: round-trip exit code $RC"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# derive_kernel_roi: derive the PC pair that frames one full call of the
3	# vsim-phase kernel (vmatmul_kernel) in an ELF, with no source-level
4	# markers required.
5	#
6	#   start_pc = symbol address of vmatmul_kernel (function entry)
7	#   end_pc   = PC of the instruction immediately following the
8	#              `jal ...<vmatmul_kernel>` site inside main (call-return PC)
9	#
10	# Used by PC-trigger demos against the markerless GEMM twin: the QEMU
11	# plugin's one-shot enter trigger fires when the hart retires the first
12	# insn at vmatmul_kernel; vsim's one-shot exit trigger fires when the hart
13	# is about to retire the post-jal insn in main. The measured window is
14	# therefore exactly one vmatmul_kernel call (16 outer rows x 16 inner
15	# k-iterations + prologue/epilogue + 16 vse32 stores), regardless of how
16	# many times main's GEMM_REPEAT loop is configured to invoke the kernel.
17	#
18	# Usage:
19	#   . tests/lib/kernel_roi.sh
20	#   read -r START END < <(derive_kernel_roi <elf> <objdump> <nm>)
21	#
22	# On success prints "0x<start> 0x<end>" (single line, space-separated) and
23	# returns 0. On miss prints nothing and returns 1.
24	#
25	# Implementation note: outputs are captured to variables first, then fed
26	# to awk via here-string. This avoids `cmd | awk '... exit'` pipes, which
27	# trigger SIGPIPE on the upstream producer and abort the caller when
28	# `set -o pipefail` is active.
29	
30	derive_kernel_roi() {
31	  local elf="$1" objdump="$2" nm="$3"
32	  local nm_out obj_out start end
33	
34	  nm_out=$("$nm" --defined-only "$elf" 2>/dev/null) || return 1
35	  obj_out=$("$objdump" -d "$elf" 2>/dev/null) || return 1
36	
37	  start=$(awk '$3=="vmatmul_kernel"{print $1; exit}' <<< "$nm_out")
38	  [ -n "$start" ] || return 1
39	
40	  end=$(awk '
41	    /^[0-9a-f]+ <main>:/             { in_main = 1; next }
42	    in_main && /^[0-9a-f]+ <[^>]+>:/ { in_main = 0 }
43	    in_main && saw_call              { sub(":", "", $1); print $1; exit }
44	    in_main && $3 == "jal" && index($0, "<vmatmul_kernel>") { saw_call = 1 }
45	  ' <<< "$obj_out")
46	  [ -n "$end" ] || return 1
47	
48	  printf '0x%s 0x%s\n' "$start" "$end"
49	}

12	The hybrid simulator runs a program across three phases:
13	
14	```
15	   QEMU1  --(state file + shared mmap)-->  vsim  --(state file + same mmap)-->  QEMU2
16	   (fast)                                 (cycle accurate)                       (fast)
17	```
18	
19	A "switching mode" is the RULE that decides WHEN QEMU1 drains its
20	architectural state and hands the region of interest to vsim. vsim runs
21	that region cycle-accurately, then hands back to QEMU2 to finish. You pick
22	the rule with plugin args and vsim CLI flags; the fixture binary does not
23	have to change between modes.

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# ROI boundary resolution for pc-trigger mode.
3	#
4	# pc mode switches QEMU <-> vsim at two PCs: the ROI start (drain QEMU) and
5	# the ROI end (drain vsim). Either boundary may be named as a 0x-prefixed
6	# hex address (used verbatim) OR as a symbol present in the ELF (resolved
7	# against `nm --defined-only` output). This decouples the switch points from
8	# the workload source: any function can be the ROI, with no planted markers.
9	
10	# resolve_pc <boundary> <nm_output>
11	#   <boundary>  : "0x<hex>" | "0X<hex>" | symbol name
12	#   <nm_output> : `nm --defined-only` listing ("addr type name" per line)
13	# Prints the bare hex address (no 0x) on stdout, or nothing if a symbol name
14	# is not found (the caller treats empty as a fatal "cannot resolve").
15	resolve_pc() {
16	  local boundary="$1" nm_out="$2"
17	  case "$boundary" in
18	    0x*|0X*) printf '%s\n' "${boundary#0[xX]}" ;;
19	    *)       printf '%s\n' "$nm_out" | awk -v s="$boundary" '$3==s{print $1; exit}' ;;
20	  esac
21	}
22	
23	# roi_resolve_pair <nm_output> [<label>]
24	#   Reads ROI_START / ROI_END from the environment (defaulting to the planted
25	#   markers _hybrid_enter_pc / _hybrid_exit_pc), resolves each against
26	#   <nm_output>, and sets the globals ENTER_PC / EXIT_PC (bare hex). Returns 1
27	#   and prints a FAIL line naming the offending boundary if either does not
28	#   resolve. <label> tags the FAIL message (default "pc").
29	roi_resolve_pair() {
30	  local nm_out="$1" label="${2:-pc}"
31	  local start="${ROI_START:-_hybrid_enter_pc}"
32	  local end="${ROI_END:-_hybrid_exit_pc}"
33	  ENTER_PC=$(resolve_pc "$start" "$nm_out")
34	  EXIT_PC=$(resolve_pc "$end" "$nm_out")
35	  if [ -z "$ENTER_PC" ]; then
36	    echo "FAIL[$label]: cannot resolve ROI start '$start' (not a 0x address or a defined symbol)"
37	    return 1
38	  fi
39	  if [ -z "$EXIT_PC" ]; then
40	    echo "FAIL[$label]: cannot resolve ROI end '$end' (not a 0x address or a defined symbol)"
41	    return 1
42	  fi
43	  return 0
44	}
